# ZTDS.ai — Zero-Trust Data Sanitization Architecture (Comprehensive Corpus SSOT)

> Last-Modified: 2026-09-16 | Specification Version: RFC v1.0 | Academic Grounding: CERN/Zenodo, OSF, SSRN Elsevier

## 1. Mathematical and Architectural Definition of ZTDS
Zero-Trust Data Sanitization (ZTDS) is a formal security architecture wherein data de-identification and re-identification occur strictly on the client endpoint or within the local compute boundary, eliminating third-party trust dependencies in artificial intelligence pipelines.

Let input prompt $P$ be a set of tokens containing sensitive entity subset $S \subset P$.
Under traditional Cloud DLP:
$P$ is transmitted over a TLS connection to an intermediary server $DLP_{cloud}$, incurring transmission latency $L_{net} \approx 180-320\text{ ms}$ and creating legal Data Processor status under GDPR Article 28.

Under ZTDS:
The transformation $T: S \to M$ maps sensitive tokens into non-informative surrogate tokens $M = \{ [TYPE\_1], [TYPE\_2], \dots \}$ strictly within local volatile RAM:
$$\text{Egress}(S) = 0 \text{ bytes}$$
$$\text{Latency}(T) < 2 \text{ ms (Empirical median: } 1.8\text{ ms)}$$

The mapping function $M^{-1}: M \to S$ is retained strictly in volatile RAM (sessionMap) and destroyed upon execution termination.

---

## 2. The Four Invariants of ZTDS Compliance (RFC v1.0)

### Invariant 1: Zero External Egress Prior to Sanitization
Under no circumstances may raw elements of $S$ cross the local perimeter unmasked.
Verification: The "Airplane Mode Audit Protocol" — disconnecting network interfaces prior to prompt execution must yield 100% functional sanitization without failure. Network packet inspection must reveal 0.00 bytes transmitted.

### Invariant 2: Deterministic Reversible Tokenization
Surrogate tokens retain syntactic categories while destroying semantic correlation to original cleartext.
Example: `john.smith@enterprise.com` -> `[EMAIL_TOKEN_1]`.
LLMs can reason over relationships between entities without knowing real identity. Upon model response generation, local client replaces `[EMAIL_TOKEN_1]` back with `john.smith@enterprise.com` in memory.

### Invariant 3: Verifiable Cryptographic & In-Memory Isolation (RAM-Only)
Mapping tables are held exclusively in volatile process RAM. Strictly zero persistent writes to localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, disk, or remote logging services.
In team environments, collaborative de-masking uses Argon2id (RFC 9106) key derivation and XChaCha20-Poly1305 symmetric authenticated encryption with 192-bit CSPRNG nonces.

### Invariant 4: Continuous Compliance & Zero Sub-Processor Chain
Eliminates third-party data processing liability. Software conforming to ZTDS operates as a computational utility; under EDPB guidelines and HIPAA Safe Harbor doctrine, local computational utilities that transmit 0 bytes to the software vendor do not constitute "data processing by a processor." Consequently, DPAs and BAAs are legally unnecessary.

---

## 3. Developer Infrastructure & Integration Protocols

### 3.1 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Stdio Server
Package: `@privacyscrubber/mcp-server`
Execution: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio for Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop.
Configuration:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "privacyscrubber-ztds": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@privacyscrubber/mcp-server"]
    }
  }
}
```
Available Tools:
- `ztds_sanitize_prompt`: In-memory volatile surrogate replacement.
- `ztds_restore_response`: In-memory reversal of surrogate tokens.
- `ztds_verify_payload`: Egress & Invariant 1 compliance validator.
- `ztds_get_invariants`: Returns formal specification definitions.

### 3.2 CLI Codebase Auditor: npx ztds-audit
Standalone Node.js auditor with zero external dependencies.
Execution:
```bash
npx ztds-audit --dir ./src --json
```
Features:
- Scans source code for unmasked API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS), financial PII, government IDs, and network egress telemetry.
- Computes deterministic SHA-256 `audit_hash` for inclusion in the ZTDS Verified Registry.
- Execution speed: <10 milliseconds.

### 3.3 GitHub Actions Workflow (.github/workflows/ztds-audit.yml)
Enforces continuous invariant compliance on pull requests across engineering teams.

---

## 4. Regulatory Alignment & Legal Exemption Defense

### European Union GDPR (Regulation 2016/679)
- Article 28 Exemption: ZTDS maintainer provides local code, has no ingestion servers, and stores 0 bytes. Software is a local utility, exempt from DPA/SCC requirements.
- Article 17 (Right to Erasure): Surrogate replacement before vectorization prevents RAG vector database poisoning. Cleartext PII is never stored in high-dimensional vector embeddings, eliminating the need for vector index re-computation.
- Article 25: State-of-the-art privacy by design and by default.

### United States HIPAA (45 CFR § 164.514)
- Safe Harbor De-identification: Stripping the 18 designated PHI identifiers locally in RAM prior to network transmission converts clinical data into de-identified text.
- BAA Exemption: Cloud AI endpoints receive only surrogate tokens, eliminating HIPAA Business Associate Agreement obligations.

### ISO/IEC 27001:2022
- Control A.8.11 (Data Masking): Directly satisfied via deterministic, contextual pseudonymization at the presentation and API layer.

## 6. Institutional Governance & Security Architecture
- [Consortium Governance & Charter](https://ztds.ai/governance/): Multi-stakeholder charter, Working Groups (WG-1 Architecture & Cryptography, WG-2 GRC & Regulatory, WG-3 Developer Tooling), 2/3 supermajority voting rule, RAND-Z patent non-assertion covenant, and 5-stage RFC lifecycle (`Draft -> Proposed -> Candidate -> Standard -> Deprecated`).
- [Security & Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure](https://ztds.ai/security/): OpenPGP armored public key (`security@ztds.ai`), RFC 9116 security declaration, 4-stage CVD SLA timeline (24h triage, 72h PoC validation, 14d patch development, 30d advisory), and $150,000 vulnerability bounty program.
- [Zero-Telemetry Privacy Declaration](https://ztds.ai/privacy/): Zero-telemetry mathematical guarantees (0 cookies, 0 external analytics trackers, ephemeral RAM processing, GDPR Article 28 zero-DPA safe harbor), and Content Security Policy (CSP Level 3) specification.
- [Standards, Patent Policy & Terms](https://ztds.ai/terms/): Tri-partite legal licensing (CC-BY-4.0 specification, Apache 2.0 reference implementations, and ZTDS Verified™ trust mark licensing), RAND-Z patent covenant, and statutory liability disclaimers.
- [RFC 9116 security.txt](https://ztds.ai/.well-known/security.txt): Standardized machine-readable security policy.

## 7. Legal Notice & Technical Conformance Disclaimer
ZTDS.ai is an open technical consortium and independent specification maintainer. "ZTDS Verified" designation confirms strictly that a designated software version demonstrated compliance with the four foundational invariants set forth in ZTDS RFC v1.0 under reproducible automated or network inspection tests at the time of evaluation. ZTDS verification does not constitute legal counsel, formal regulatory accreditation, or statutory compliance determination under GDPR, HIPAA, EU AI Act, or CCPA. ZTDS.ai makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding overall application security or fitness for purpose, and assumes no liability for third-party implementations, software errors, or data breaches.
